operations.description: Send a question or instruction to a Groq model and get a text reply.

inputs.description: What you want the model to answer or do.
inputs.label: Question
inputs.name: prompt

inputs.description: From 0 to 2. Lower is more focused, higher is more varied.
inputs.label: Temperature
inputs.name: temperature

inputs.description: Longest reply in tokens, about 4 characters each.
inputs.label: Maximum Tokens
inputs.name: maxTokens

inputs.description: From 0 to 1. Adjust this or Temperature, not both.
inputs.label: Top P
inputs.name: topP

inputs.description: From -2 to 2. Groq models do not support this yet.
inputs.label: Frequency Penalty
inputs.name: frequencyPenalty

inputs.description: From -2 to 2. Groq models do not support this yet.
inputs.label: Presence Penalty
inputs.name: presencePenalty

inputs.description: Runs that share this ID continue one conversation. Empty: no memory.

inputs.name: memoryKey

inputs.description: Messages sent before the question, such as a system instruction.
inputs.label: Roles
inputs.name: roles

inputs.description: flac, mp3, mp4, mpeg, mpga, m4a, ogg, wav or webm.

inputs.name: file

inputs.description: ISO-639-1 code of the spoken language, for better accuracy.

inputs.name: language

inputs.description: Spellings or text that came just before, in the audio's language.

inputs.name: prompt
